key: Hail, Trainer.
en: Hail, Trainer.
ja: やあ、トレーナー。

key: City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
en: City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
ja: 自警団はトラブルに目を光らせている。何か怪しいものを見かけたら、我々に報告してくれ。

key: I could sit here and stare at the water with you until we wither away.
en: I could sit here and stare at the water with you until we wither away.
ja: 君とここに座って、朽ち果てるまでずっとこの水を眺めていられそうだ。

key: If we leave it in the hands of the young...
en: If we leave it in the hands of the young...
ja: 若い世代に任せておけば……

key: This world is going to be just fine, isn't it?
en: This world is going to be just fine, isn't it?
ja: この世界はきっと大丈夫だよな?

key: Gotta hand it to xem, that Adrienn character really knows how to take a mess, and fix it into something great!
en: Gotta hand it to xem, that Adrienn character really knows how to take a mess, and fix it into something great!
ja: 認めるしかないな、あのアドリエンヌってやつは、めちゃくちゃなものを素晴らしいものに変える術を本当に心得てる!

key: Before everything happened, Beryl used to just be a pile of houses.
en: Before everything happened, Beryl used to just be a pile of houses.
ja: すべてが起きる前、ベリルはただの家の寄せ集めだった。

key: It takes some real creativity to see a mangle of rubble and roots and say "This should be a park!"
en: It takes some real creativity to see a mangle of rubble and roots and say "This should be a park!"
ja: がれきと根っこが絡み合った場所を見て「ここは公園にすべきだ!」と言えるのは、よほどの発想力がいる。

key: Tch, I don't suppose you wanna hang out, do you?
en: Tch, I don't suppose you wanna hang out, do you?
ja: チッ、一緒に遊ぶ気なんてないだろうけどさ。

key: I feel like parks in the middle of the night should be a rad place to meet people.
en: I feel like parks in the middle of the night should be a rad place to meet people.
ja: 真夜中の公園って、人と出会うにはイケてる場所な気がするんだけどな。

key: But other than you, the only person I've seen here so far is a stupid hobo! Ew!
en: But other than you, the only person I've seen here so far is a stupid hobo! Ew!
ja: でもあんた以外にここで見かけたのは、バカなホームレスだけ! 最悪!

key: Hmph, being back after all this time feels weird.
en: Hmph, being back after all this time feels weird.
ja: フン、こんなに経ってから戻ってくるのって、なんだか変な感じ。

key: After my home was destroyed, I decided to leave on a journey to become a Pokémon Trainer.
en: After my home was destroyed, I decided to leave on a journey to become a Pokémon Trainer.
ja: 家が壊されたあと、ポケモントレーナーになるために旅に出ることにしたの。

key: Now that I can go back to my old life...
en: Now that I can go back to my old life...
ja: 元の生活に戻れるようになった今……

key: Yeah, like hell I would.
en: Yeah, like hell I would.
ja: そんなの、絶対にごめんだけどね。

key: Tch, I've been through some kinda mess in the time that I couldn't stay here.
en: Tch, I've been through some kinda mess in the time that I couldn't stay here.
ja: チッ、ここにいられなかった間、いろいろ厄介なことに巻き込まれたんだから。

key: Listen, kid.
en: Listen, kid.
ja: いいか、坊主。

key: If you ever offer someone to crash at your place, make sure you don't attach strings to it.
en: If you ever offer someone to crash at your place, make sure you don't attach strings to it.
ja: 誰かを泊めてやるときは、絶対に見返りを求めるんじゃないぞ。

key: If any guy says you can crash at their place for free, don't believe them.
en: If any guy says you can crash at their place for free, don't believe them.
ja: タダで泊めてやるなんて言う男がいたら、信じちゃだめだぞ。

key: That's all I'm gonna say.
en: That's all I'm gonna say.
ja: 言いたいのはそれだけだ。

key: "Kingsbury Station"
en: "Kingsbury Station"
ja: 「キングスベリー駅」

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
ja: 何か見えない気配が道をふさいでいる。

key: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
en: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
ja: \PNはシルボンスコープを使った。

key: The startled Pokémon attacked!
en: The startled Pokémon attacked!
ja: 驚いたポケモンがおそいかかってきた!

key: "The Emporium--
en: "The Emporium--
ja: 「エンポリアム――

key: Come in today!
en: Come in today!
ja: 今すぐご来店を!

key: Or don't.
en: Or don't.
ja: 来なくてもいいけど。

key: Don't let me tell you what to do."
en: Don't let me tell you what to do."
ja: 別に指図する気はないから」

en: <>- Kingsbury Street\n^v -Crystal Street
ja: <>- キングスベリー通り\n^v -クリスタル通り
